stem:
Gemma reads a book for 1 hour and 20 minutes. She finishes reading at 7:13 p.m. as shown on the clock.

What time did Gemma start reading her book?
difficulty_rationale: Requires subtracting time duration (1 hour 20 minutes) from given end time (7:13 p.m.) to find the start time, involving multiple steps and time calculation.
